a.statement: An instrument is a stabilized apparatus whose boundary has been stabilized into invisibility, rendering its own material entanglement as the silent condition of its function.

b.statement: The glitch, sensor noise, and algorithmic error are not failures but the apparatus's authentic voice—a post-print membrane that trembles with invited perturbations, keeping the cut open so that ache indexes unfinishedness as the condition of aliveness. Art's work is not to correct information but to re-materialize the feedback loop—bringing the glitch, latency, and calcium skeleton.
